verdict.rationale: cubic's docs describe installing a GitHub app that automatically reviews new pull requests and posts review comments in threaded PR conversations that can be replied to and auto-resolved, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that findings are posted as line-level inline review comments (only implied by review threads), evidence of review turnaround within minutes (the 'minutes' claim refers to setup), any GitLab support (evidence is GitHub-only), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer installs as a GitHub/GitLab app and posts reviews as native inline comments on my pull requests within minutes

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
To review a PR that was opened _before_ you installed the app, comment: `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`.
Comments on bugs and improvements in pull requests
Enable automatic thread resolution to close findings when the issue is fixed
You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly, or reply to cubic's existing comments to continue the conversation.
Get started with cubic AI code review in minutes.
